description: Canonical pure-English CuraFit coaching, brief, readiness, eligibility, and plan guidance codes. Server emits canonical English text plus code and params; KMM clients localize into Arabic and other languages by code + params.

RED_FLAGS_STOP.message: Urgent safety notice: stop exercising immediately and seek medical evaluation for symptoms such as chest pain or severe dizziness.

WORKOUT_PAIN_HOLD.message: Pain was logged during your recent workout, so load progression is paused. Update your recovery check-in before resuming heavy effort.

FEEDBACK_PAIN_HOLD.message: You reported pain as a training barrier. Stop painful movements and submit a pain-free recovery check-in before increasing load.

CHECKIN_MISSING_OR_STALE.message: Submit today's recovery check-in (sleep, fatigue, and pain status) so the CuraFit Specialist Team can safely calibrate today's workout load.

ILLNESS_HOLD.message: Health comes first: pause today's workout while experiencing illness symptoms and consult a clinician if symptoms persist.

JOINT_PAIN_HOLD.message: Joint pain reported; pause painful movements, use safe alternatives or rest, and pause progression until pain resolves.

RECOVERY_READY.message: Current recovery check-in supports normal training intensity while monitoring technique and perceived effort.

RECOVERY_DELOAD_SUGGESTED.message: Multiple fatigue or sleep indicators are elevated; a temporary 24-hour set reduction is recommended pending your approval.

RECOVERY_DELOAD_PROPOSAL.message: Based on recent recovery strain, we propose temporarily reducing working sets for 24 hours; applying this adjustment requires your approval.

RECOVERY_ADJUSTMENT_ACTIVE.message: Your approved temporary set reduction is currently active for today's workout.

RECOVERY_ADVICE_DECLINED.message: Your previous choice to decline the set reduction is saved. Your workout plan remains unchanged until a new recovery check-in is logged.

SCHEDULE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.message: Confirm your weekly workout days before CuraFit Specialist Team training and adaptive reviews run.

HEALTH_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.message: Confirm health readiness clearance before CuraFit Specialist Team reviews run.

WORKOUT_SAFETY_EXCLUSION_HOLD.message: Your current workout plan contains movements excluded for your declared injuries; swap them or regenerate your plan before progressing.

PLAN_CONSTRAINTS_VERIFICATION_FAILED.message: Your existing nutrition plan no longer satisfies current dietary constraints; regenerate your plan.

RECOVERY_NOT_READY_FOR_CALORIE_CHANGE.message: Calorie adjustments are paused until sleep and recovery readiness stabilize.

WORKOUTS_ONLY_TRACK.message: Your account is currently on the workouts-only track with no active nutrition plan.

GOAL_WEIGHT_REACHED_MAINTENANCE.message: Your 7-day average weight has reached your target weight ({averageWeight} kg). We propose transitioning to a maintenance plan.

MAINTENANCE_ADVICE_DECLINED.message: Your choice to decline the maintenance transition is saved. Your current goal remains unchanged until new data arrives.

COOLDOWN_14D.message: Monitoring your response to the last adjustment; at least 14 days are required before proposing another calorie or volume change.

INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_COVERAGE.message: Keep logging: adaptive calorie reviews require at least 3 weigh-ins in each of the last 2 weeks and 10 adherent complete food days.

WEIGHT_SAMPLING_TOO_CLOSE.message: Spread weigh-ins across the week so trend velocity can be calculated reliably.

TREND_ON_TRACK.message: Your 2-week weight trend ({rate}%/week) is within the expected target range; no calorie adjustment is needed.

CALORIE_DEFICIT_STEP.message: Based on adherent food logs and a {rate}%/week weight trend, we propose a modest {delta} kcal daily reduction.

CALORIE_SURPLUS_STEP.message: Based on adherent food logs and a {rate}%/week weight trend, we propose a modest +{delta} kcal daily increase.

PERFORMANCE_DROP_CALORIE_CUT_HOLD.message: Training performance declined recently; calories are held steady to protect lean mass and recovery instead of cutting further.

APPETITE_ENERGY_REVIEW_REQUIRED.message: High hunger or low energy was recently logged; calories are held steady pending follow-up instead of reducing right now.

CALORIE_ADVICE_DECLINED.message: Your previous choice to decline a calorie change is saved; your plan was not modified.

MIN_SAFE_ENERGY_FLOOR_HOLD.message: Calories were held at the safe planning floor ({minEnergyFloor} kcal) instead of reducing further.

MAX_SAFE_ENERGY_CEILING_HOLD.message: Calories were held at the safe planning ceiling ({maxEnergyCeiling} kcal).

MATERNAL_CALORIE_CUT_BLOCKED.message: Calorie reductions are disabled during pregnancy for maternal safety.

PLAN_CONSTRAINTS_ADJUSTMENT_HOLD.message: Current calories were kept because the proposed change could not satisfy your dietary, macro, or exclusion constraints.

HEALTH_OR_SCHEDULE_UNCONFIRMED.message: Confirm health readiness and workout schedule before volume progression is evaluated.

GOAL_NOT_MUSCLE_GAIN.message: Progressive weekly set increases apply to muscle-gain plans; holding volume does not mean your current training is insufficient.

RECOVERY_BASELINE_NOT_READY.message: At least 7 valid recovery check-ins are needed to establish a baseline before proposing extra weekly sets.

INSUFFICIENT_SESSION_ADHERENCE.message: Complete at least 80% of scheduled sessions over the past 2 weeks before adding weekly volume.

WEEKLY_VOLUME_INCREASE_PROPOSED.message: Strong adherence and stable performance over the last 3 exposures support adding +{extraSets} weekly set.

VOLUME_INCREASE_NOT_JUSTIFIED.message: Current workout logs do not yet meet criteria for adding weekly volume; continue consistent logging.

WORKOUT_RESCHEDULE_PROPOSAL.message: Confirm moving your scheduled workout from {fromDate} to {toDate} while keeping daily calorie targets steady.

ADAPTATION_PROPOSED.message: A new coaching recommendation is ready for your review and approval.

NO_CHANGE_NEEDED.message: No plan adjustment is proposed based on current evidence; review coverage and readiness details below.

INSUFFICIENT_EXPOSURES_OR_RECOVERY.message: Log at least two comparable sessions with ready recovery before load increases are suggested.

UNILATERAL_BOTH_SIDES_REQUIRED.message: Confirm both left and right sides are completed equally before increasing load on unilateral exercises.

REP_OR_RIR_THRESHOLD_NOT_MET.message: Reach the top of the prescribed rep range at or above target RIR across two sessions before increasing weight.

UNIFORM_LOAD_REQUIRED.message: Complete all working sets at the same load across two sessions before increasing weight.

BODYWEIGHT_PROGRESSION_REPS_ONLY.message: Progress bodyweight movements through additional reps and tempo control.

VALID_INCREMENT_REQUIRED.message: Current weight increment exceeds conservative progression bounds (<= 5%); build reps and control first.

DOUBLE_PROGRESSION_READY.message: Target reps achieved cleanly across two consecutive sessions; consider progressing to {kg} kg if technique and recovery feel solid.

AGE_UNSUPPORTED_OR_MISSING.message: CuraFit Specialist Team plans are available for adults aged 18 to 95 only.

SENIOR_MODE_ACTIVE.message: Senior safety mode (70+) is active: moderate deficit cap (-400 kcal), protein floor >= 1.2 g/kg, and joint-friendly low-impact exercises.

CLINICAL_OR_INJURY_REQUIRES_REVIEW.message: Declared clinical conditions or injuries require direct specialist review before plan generation.

BMI_OUT_OF_RANGE.message: Height and weight fall outside the standard CuraFit Specialist Team planning BMI range (12.5 to 65).

UNDERWEIGHT_LOSS_FORBIDDEN.message: Weight loss goals are unsafe when current BMI is below 18.5.

MATERNAL_WEIGHT_LOSS_FORBIDDEN.message: Weight loss goals are disabled during pregnancy for maternal and fetal safety.

CONFIRM_WORKOUT_HEALTH.message: Confirm that you have no acute condition or injury requiring specialist clearance before starting workouts.

CONFIRM_EXTERNAL_TRAINING_DAYS.message: Optional: specify external resistance training days per week for muscle-gain nutrition calibration.

BRIEF_FOOD_COMPLETE.message: Food diary for {date} is complete. Consistent logging enables accurate weekly reviews.

BRIEF_FOOD_PARTIAL.message: You have logged {entriesCount} meal(s) today and your day is still open; finish logging as you eat.

BRIEF_FOOD_MISSING.message: No meals logged yet today; start by logging your next actual meal.

BRIEF_PROTEIN_STATUS.message: Logged protein today is {actualProtein} g against your {targetProtein} g target.

BRIEF_WEIGHT_TREND.message: Current 7-day average weight is {currentAvg} kg ({currentCount} logs) vs. {previousAvg} kg ({previousCount} logs) last week.

BRIEF_WEIGHT_COVERAGE.message: You have {count} weigh-ins in the last 14 days; log at least 3 weigh-ins per week for reliable trend comparisons.

BRIEF_PLAN_EXPIRED.message: Your previous 7-day nutrition plan has ended. Renew your plan to generate targets for the upcoming week.

BRIEF_HIGH_HUNGER.message: You logged hunger {hunger}/5 on {date}; calorie reductions are paused while we monitor appetite and energy.

BRIEF_TRAINING_SAFETY.message: Current recovery or safety flags indicate pausing heavy exercise and reviewing symptoms first.

BRIEF_TRAINING_SCHEDULED.message: Today's scheduled workout is {focus}. Current readiness supports your planned session.

BRIEF_TRAINING_REST.message: Rest day today. Focus on sleep, hydration, and nutrition ahead of your next session.

BRIEF_TRAINING_COMPLETED.message: Workout session for {date} is logged as completed. Great consistency.

BRIEF_TRAINING_PARTIAL.message: Today's workout is logged as partial; logging actual effort protects recovery and progression accuracy.

BRIEF_TRAINING_MISSED.message: Today's workout is marked missed. Resume normally on your next scheduled day without doubling volume.

BRIEF_FOLLOWUP_SHORT_SLEEP.message: Last logged sleep was {sleepHours} hours on {date}; prioritize recovery and earlier wind-down tonight.

BRIEF_FOLLOWUP_RETURN.message: Welcome back! Last logged activity was on {lastDate}. Resume smoothly without trying to compensate for missed days.

BRIEF_FIRST_WEEK.message: First-week onboarding guidance (Day {day}/7): build a simple, repeatable logging habit.

COACHING_BARRIER_AGREEMENT.message: A structured coaching agreement is proposed for your reported {barrier} barrier.

COACHING_BARRIER_QUESTION.message: Tell us the main barrier affecting your recent {domain} consistency so we can choose a realistic next step.

COACHING_REVIEW_DUE.message: Your agreed coaching step is due for review. Report whether it helped, did not help, or was not tried.

COMEBACK_DELOAD_ACTIVE.message: Gentle comeback ramp-in is active ({setFactor}x sets) to help you rebuild momentum safely.

BRIEF_TRAINING_PERFORMANCE.message: Average load for {exerciseId} moved from {fromKg} to {toKg} kg; prioritizing recovery before pushing load or deeper calorie cuts.

BRIEF_FOLLOWUP_TIRED.message: You reported low energy or fatigue during follow-up; training load and calorie cuts are held conservatively.

BRIEF_FOLLOWUP_SLEEP.message: Last logged sleep was {sleepHours} hours on {date}. Consistent logging helps spot trends early.

BRIEF_FOLLOWUP_ACTIVITY.message: Recent daily step or movement feedback was logged and factored into your weekly coaching context.

VOLUME_HOLD.message: Weekly volume for {muscle} is held at {currentSets} sets while monitoring recovery and progression.

CARDIO_HIGH_IMPACT_CAUTION.message: High-impact cardio ({modality}) logged alongside joint, pregnancy, or senior safety considerations ({reasons}); consider low-impact alternatives like walking, cycling, or swimming if discomfort arises.

CYCLE_LUTEAL_WATER_RETENTION.message: Cycle day {cycleDay} (late luteal phase): temporary 0.5-2.0 kg water retention is normal; stay steady on your calorie target and avoid reacting to short-term scale jumps.

CYCLE_MENSTRUAL_GENTLE_TRAINING.message: Cycle day {cycleDay} (menstrual phase): listen to energy and cramp levels; lighter loads, walking, or extra rest are completely normal today.

CYCLE_FOLLICULAR_PEAK_READINESS.message: Cycle day {cycleDay} (follicular phase): energy and recovery readiness are often higher during this window; a good time for quality resistance sessions.

CYCLE_PAUSED_PREGNANCY.message: Menstrual cycle predictions are paused during pregnancy ({maternalStatus}); maternal safety guidance remains active.

BRIEF_TRAINING_PERFORMANCE_UP.message: Average load for {exerciseId} progressed from {fromKg} to {toKg} kg.

SPLIT_REVIEW_SUGGEST_UPPER_LOWER.message: Because you train {days}+ days consistently with ready recovery, Upper/Lower or Push/Pull/Legs is available in Preferences if sessions feel long or you prefer dedicated focus days.

SPLIT_REVIEW_KEEP_FULL_BODY.message: At {days} training days per week, continuing with Full Body remains practical and time-efficient.

SPLIT_REVIEW_RECOVERY_FIRST.message: Submit a fresh ready recovery check-in first; when managing pain or fatigue, recovery takes priority over changing splits.

SPLIT_REVIEW_BUILD_CONSISTENCY.message: Focus on session consistency first; build at least 16 completed sessions ({completedCount} logged) and steady recent adherence before switching splits.

SPLIT_REVIEW_NOT_DUE.message: 8-week Full Body split review is available after 8 weeks and 16+ completed workouts on a 4+ day Full Body program.

SEASONAL_EID_FLEX_ACTIVE.message: Seasonal Flex Mode ({occasion}) is active through {endDate} at maintenance calories without streak penalty.

CYCLE_GENTLE_SESSION_ACTIVE.message: Cycle comfort adjustment is active with 0.8x working sets for 24 hours.

PARQ_CLEARANCE_REQUIRED.message: Physician clearance is required before workout planning after a positive PAR-Q screening response. You can switch to nutrition_only in the meantime.

CONFLICTING_CONDITIONS.message: diabetes_t1 and diabetes_t2 are mutually exclusive and cannot be selected together.

MULTI_CONDITION_CLINICAL_REVIEW.message: Multiple overlapping or high-acuity clinical conditions require direct specialist review before plan generation.

MULTI_INJURY_WARNING.message: Three concurrent injuries limit available exercises; monitor joint comfort closely or consider switching to nutrition_only during recovery.

MULTI_INJURY_REQUIRES_REVIEW.message: Four or more concurrent injuries (or infeasible workout day coverage) require specialist review before workout planning; switch to nutrition_only or seek clinical clearance.

PLAN_HYPOTHYROID_REE_CALIBRATION.message: Applied conservative 5% REE calibration for hypothyroidism; monitor actual weight trend.

PLAN_SENIOR_DEFICIT_CAP.message: Senior safety mode (70+): daily calorie deficit capped at -400 kcal.

PLAN_RECOMPOSITION_MAINTENANCE.message: Body recomposition starts at maintenance calories with progressive resistance training.

PLAN_ADAPTIVE_GOAL_PACE.message: Goal pace sets a bounded initial offset; actual energy needs are calibrated from recorded weight trends.

PLAN_PREGNANCY_T1_CALIBRATION.message: First-trimester pregnancy calibration applied (maintenance baseline, calorie deficits disabled).

PLAN_PREGNANCY_T2_CALIBRATION.message: Second-trimester pregnancy calibration applied (+340 kcal/day, deficits and extra gain surplus disabled).

PLAN_PREGNANCY_T3_CALIBRATION.message: Third-trimester pregnancy calibration applied (+450 kcal/day, deficits and extra gain surplus disabled).

PLAN_BREASTFEEDING_CALIBRATION.message: Breastfeeding calibration applied (+400 kcal baseline, max deficit -300 kcal/day).

PLAN_MIN_ENERGY_FLOOR_APPLIED.message: Daily energy raised to the safe planning floor ({minEnergyFloor} kcal).

PLAN_MAX_ENERGY_CEILING_APPLIED.message: Daily energy capped at the safe planning ceiling (4200 kcal).

PLAN_UNDERWEIGHT_NUTRIENT_CARE.message: BMI is below 18.5 (underweight): focus on nutrient-dense meals and gradual intake progression.

PLAN_ABW_PROTEIN_SCALING.message: Protein targets use Adjusted Body Weight (ABW) for BMI > 30 to avoid excessive portions.

PLAN_GOUT_PROTEIN_CAP.message: Protein capped at 1.4 g/kg and high-purine red meats/offal excluded for gout.

PLAN_KIDNEY_PROTEIN_CAP.message: Protein conservatively capped at <= 1.1 g/kg for kidney condition support.

PLAN_IBS_EXCLUSIONS_ACTIVE.message: Heavy legumes, cabbage, and raw alliums excluded for IBS comfort.

PLAN_HYPERTENSION_SODIUM_CEILING.message: Low-sodium ceiling and high-sodium cheese exclusions enabled for blood pressure support.

PLAN_CELIAC_GLUTEN_EXCLUSION.message: Gluten-containing grains and breads are excluded for celiac safety.

PLAN_FAVISM_EXCLUSION.message: Fava beans and falafel are excluded for favism (G6PD) safety.

PLAN_LACTOSE_EXCLUSION.message: Dairy products are excluded for lactose intolerance comfort.

PLAN_GLYCEMIC_CARB_CALIBRATION.message: Carbohydrate share calibrated to ~38% of daily energy for glycemic support.

PLAN_GAIN_WITHOUT_RESISTANCE.message: Calorie surplus without resistance training does not guarantee lean mass gain.

PLAN_MUSCLE_GAIN_SURPLUS.message: Muscle gain targets use a moderate surplus (<= 250 kcal) and progressive resistance training.

WORKOUT_INJURY_EXCLUSIONS_ACTIVE.message: Movements contraindicated for declared injuries were excluded precautionarily; remaining selections are not medical clearance. Stop any painful movement.

WORKOUT_SENIOR_SAFETY_ACTIVE.message: Senior safety mode (70+): high-impact plyometrics and heavy spinal loading were excluded.

WORKOUT_PREGNANCY_SAFETY_ACTIVE.message: Pregnancy safety filters active: high-impact, crunches, and post-first-trimester supine movements were excluded.

WORKOUT_SEVEN_DAY_RECOVERY_CAUTION.message: 7-day schedule detected: monitor daily recovery closely and keep intensity moderate on back-to-back sessions.

WORKOUT_SPLIT_FALLBACK_FULL_BODY.message: Selected split requires more training days; switched to Full Body for balanced muscle coverage.

WORKOUT_EQUIPMENT_FALLBACK_FULL_BODY.message: Requested split required unavailable equipment; switched to Full Body matching your equipment and time budget.

WORKOUT_MISSING_PATTERNS_NOTED.message: Some movement patterns did not fit current equipment, injuries, or session duration; gaps are noted per day.

WORKOUT_CONSECUTIVE_FULL_BODY_CAUTION.message: Consecutive Full Body training days detected; monitor recovery and prefer a rest day between sessions when possible.

WARM_CLIMATE_HYDRATION_BONUS.message: Regional warm-climate hydration bonus (+200 ml) applied.

GOUT_HYDRATION_BONUS.message: Gout support hydration bonus (+500 ml) applied.

MATERNAL_HYDRATION_BONUS.message: Maternal hydration bonus (+300 ml pregnancy / +600 ml breastfeeding) applied.

DASH_SODIUM_CEILING.message: DASH daily sodium ceiling (<= 2300 mg) active.

PLAN_WEEKLY_RENEWAL.message: Weekly nutrition plan renewed with updated targets.

COMEBACK_RAMP_IN.message: Comeback restart calibration applied for a smooth return.

RECOVERY_DELOAD_APPLIED.message: Approved temporary set reduction applied for recovery protection.

CALORIE_ADAPTATION_APPLIED.message: Approved calorie adaptation applied to upcoming plan days.
